# Jeremiah 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: "Go and-buy for-yourself a-linen waistband and-put-it on-your-loins, and-in-water do-not-put-it."

**2** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**3** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**4** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**5** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**6** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**7** Then-I-dug in-the-Euphrates, as YHWH commanded-me, and-I-took the-waistband from-the-place where I-had-hidden-it, and-behold, the-waistband was-ruined — it-was-profitable for-nothing.

**8** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**9** "Thus says YHWH: 'In-this-manner I-will-ruin the-pride-of Judah and-the-great pride-of Jerusalem.

**10** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**11** For as the-waistband clings to-the-waist-of a-man, so I-caused-to-cling to-Me all-[the]-house-of Israel and-all-[the]-house-of Judah,' declares YHWH, 'to-be to-Me for-a-people and-for-a-name and-for-praise and-for-glory; but-they-did-not listen.'

**12** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**13** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**14** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**15** Hear and-give-ear; do-not-be-proud, for YHWH has-spoken.

**16** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**17** And-if you-will-not listen-to-it, in-secret-places my-soul will-weep because-of [your]-pride, and-my-eye will-weep-bitterly and-run-down [with]-tears, because [the]-flock-of YHWH has-been-taken-captive.

**18** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**19** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**20** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**21** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**22** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**23** Can a-Cushite change his-skin, or-a-leopard his-spots? Then also you can-do-good, [you]-who-are-accustomed to-doing-evil.

**24** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**25** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**26** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-pride-of Judah and-the-desolation coming upon-them in-those-days.

**27** Your-adulteries and-your-neighings, the-lewdness-of your-prostitution, on-[the]-hills in-the-field — I-have-seen your-abominations. Woe to-you, Jerusalem! You-will-not-be-clean — after how-much longer?

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **13:1**: Opening formula for the the linen belt oracle. Standard prophetic messenger formula with characteristic Jeremianic language.

- **13:13**: Central imagery of ruined pride — characteristic of Jeremiah's prophetic rhetoric and covenant lawsuit tradition.

- **13:27**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The divine speech formula seals the prophetic oracle.

— EMET
